label: Reps
tagline: Log workouts and habits, keep the streak going

help.about: Log workouts and habits in a tap, see the streak, and look back over the weeks.

manifest.summary: A log for workouts and habits. Each tracker is one kind from kinds.json (strength sets with reps and weight, cardio minutes and distance, a counted habit, a yes/no habit; a new kind is one entry there) with a goal in days a week. Today shows every tracker with its streak (days in a row for a daily goal, weeks in a row that met the goal otherwise), the week so far and a quick log; History draws the last eight weeks as a bar chart with the best streak and every entry, which can be removed if logged by mistake. Trackers can be renamed, have their goal changed and be archived, never deleted.
